say:1:1423171001:0.text: More people are showing up each day, both at the mine and the production line.
say:1:1423171001:0.source_cn: 一天比一天多起来啦，矿洞那边也是，生产线这边也是。

say:2:1423171002:1.text: It's all thanks to the arcane steel. Word is, it works even better than echorite!
say:2:1423171002:1.source_cn: 听说研究出了什么魔钢，比深岩晶还好用，大伙正干得热火朝天呢！

say:3:1423171003:1.text: I'd better start prepping more food so everyone has something to eat after work!
say:3:1423171003:1.source_cn: 我得再多准备点，让他们干完活就能吃喝上面包和啤酒！
